metadata.title: Vintage Poker Room Calligraphy Layout
useCases: Intimate interior photography with script overlays
Vintage tavern or card game themed designs

retrievalProfile.description: A low-key, warm-toned group portrait around a table featuring heavy shadows and a prominent, white flourished script centered in the upper third.
triggerTerms: white calligraphic script on dark background
excludeWhen: brightly lit modern interiors are required
high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-key photograph of men playing cards in a dark room, anchored by a large, white, hand-lettered script title at the top and smaller signatures at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: White script floating in dark negative space above the subjects
Warm, directional lighting highlighting faces and table objects
Symmetrical placement of secondary text at the bottom corners
Deep shadows framing the central card game action
coreInvariants: Elongated calligraphic swashes in the display text
Warm, desaturated color palette with amber and brown tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-ground group of four men seated around a circular table, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white script title in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright white script, moves down to the illuminated faces and hands at the table, then settles on the smaller signatures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark, textured negative space in the upper background and lower foreground shadows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the calligraphic text and highlights on clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber, red bottle labels, and skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the white text and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with thick downstrokes
Interconnected glyphs with fluid, organic motion
Tapered terminals that end in fine points
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature oversized, circular swashes
Lower case 't' and 'l' integrate into horizontal flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent script style used for both main title and secondary signatures to maintain a unified hand-drawn feel.
graphicDevices: Horizontal swash lines separating text blocks

preserve: The flourished, calligraphic nature of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, flourished formal script feel.
Provides the necessary ornate swashes and classical cursive structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-key photograph of four men in 1970s attire playing poker in a dark, wood-paneled room. Warm lighting from above hits the table, illuminating cards, chips, and glass bottles. The top third of the image is dark, textured negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered, white calligraphic script title in the upper third. Add two smaller, matching script signatures in the bottom left and bottom right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the main text white and highly flourished?
Is the lighting warm and low-key with deep shadows?
Are the subjects arranged around a central table?
Is the overall aesthetic reminiscent of a 1970s film photograph?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
Number of people at the table
mustRedesign: Standard digital fonts without custom flourishes

mustAchieve: Authentic 70s film grain and color response
avoid: Perfectly straight, computer-generated lines in the script

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white script is legible against the dark background.
Check that the lighting feels directional and atmospheric.
Verify that the flourishes do not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Confirm the bottom signatures are balanced and small.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key interior photography + centered flourished script overlay + warm vintage color grading.
